description: This file defines the HungarianMatcher class for computing assignment between network predictions and targets in an object detection model, including cost calculations and the matching algorithm.

classes.name: HungarianMatcher
classes.description: Computes an assignment between targets and predictions for object detection, using cost weights for classification, bounding box L1 distance, and GIoU.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the HungarianMatcher with specified cost weights.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the matching between predicted outputs and targets, returning index pairs.
